assertions: Native metadata categories preserve original/effective values and pool-dependent copy targets.
Pool names,metrics,virtual secondary copies and once-only shutdown use real shared owners.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task176 implements actual named/copy SfxItemPool constructors,metadata category copy,Clone,GetName,GetMetric/SetDefaultMetric,BC and once-only sendShutdownHint. Static defaults share original metadata;dynamic defaults clone into the new owner;effective user entries and saved originals are processed independently before virtual secondary Clone linkage. All current/saved metadata is staged before virtual item Clone;MapCM remains observable during copy until the source metric is assigned. New pools start with empty broadcasters and merged-range caches,copy metrics and names,and independently gate Dying before synchronous delivery with range reset afterward. Reuse actual OUString,MapUnit,SfxBroadcaster/items/sets. Omitted browser name maps to empty native name;browser-only snapshot registry is not promoted into native metadata or copied packages. Physical refcount/cache/surrogate registries,cleanup/destructor allocation timing and post-destruction access are erased or unimplemented under GC. Presentation,full pool destruction,ScDocumentPool/Sc styles/document/connected UI/same-model ODS remain pending;whole-class parity is not claimed.

record.capability: Native named and copied item pools
gaps: Pool presentation,full destruction and native physical registries remain unimplemented or erased under GC.
Sc document/styles/UI and same-model ODS remain pending.
Existing empty-name browser construction is retained;browser snapshot registry is separate from native metadata.
Native SfxBroadcaster listener-count QA is supporting dependency context only;pool copy/shutdown fixtures are source-derived,not a claimed native pool QA suite port.
